units.source_text: 大竹七段经过长考，黑59落子，后面的三手，必须按其路数下。

en.t: After a long think, Otake 7-dan played Black 59, and the next three moves had to follow that line.
In this way, the upper side became even more stable.

units.source_text: 接着七段的黑子可以采取各种手段，虽然处在困难的节骨眼上，但转向下边，只用一分钟，就下了黑63。

en.t: Next, the 7-dan's black stones had various possible measures available; although he was at a difficult turning point, he shifted to the lower side and played Black 63 after only one minute.

units.source_text: 看样子他早已看准了这一着。

en.t: It seemed that he had long since fixed his eye on this move.

units.source_text: 另外，他在下边的白模样上，放下了试探性的一子，然后再回到上边。

en.t: Also, he placed a probing stone in White's framework on the lower side, and then returned to the upper side.

units.source_text: 据说这是大竹七段独特的凌厉进攻的招数，也许他对后面的目标已经胸有成竹。

en.t: This was said to be one of Otake 7-dan's distinctive sharp attacking methods; perhaps he already had a firm plan for his later target.

units.source_text: 放子的声音，充满了迫不及待。

en.t: The sound of the stone being placed was filled with impatience.
